reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getFillableCategories helper and uses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable(...)) registration like its siblings.

duplication.why: No selection logic is copied; only the small income/expense sign flip mirrors the one in set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits with the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered next to them in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Adds just the action, its handler, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short, follows the established pattern, and inherits any future change to which categories are fillable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getFillableCategories, the tree's shared month-wide category selection.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the one-line sign convention.
